1.1.5.title: Tautulli history imports
1.1.5.body: Upload old Tautulli backups, preview them, append watch history safely, and repair unmatched media links.

1.1.5.title: Active session popouts
1.1.5.body: Click a live session card for a richer playback inspector with stream, device, user, progress, and transcode details.

1.1.5.title: Custom profile theming
1.1.5.body: New theme controls and presets let JellyGlance feel more personal across the dashboard.

1.1.5.title: Faster profile pages
1.1.5.body: Profile stats and media sections now load with targeted requests, cache reuse, and clearer loading counts.

1.1.5.title: What's new popup
1.1.5.body: JellyGlance now shows update notes once per version, with a manual button in the profile menu whenever you want to revisit them.

1.1.5.title: Activity refresh fixes
1.1.5.body: Activity pages now refresh after imports and handle imported history more reliably.

1.1.5.title: Better session readability
1.1.5.body: Active session timing and playback text have been tightened up so live cards are easier to scan.

1.1.5.title: Repair Hub
1.1.5.body: A new navbar page pulls media repair work into one place, including missing artwork, runtime gaps, empty series, orphaned activity, and unmatched imported history.

1.1.5.title: Newsletter generator
1.1.5.body: Configure SMTP, preview a JellyGlance digest, send test emails, and manually email recently added media, top watched items, active viewers, and repair status.
